summary: This bill repeals the federal requirements that new federal buildings reduce fossil fuel-generated energy consumption by set percentages and bars green building certification systems from denying certification based on fossil fuel use.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly repeals energy efficiency standards aimed at phasing out fossil fuel use in federal buildings, which would lead to increased fossil fuel consumption and thus negatively impact environmental protection efforts. The core purpose of the bill is to reverse environmental regulations related to energy use.
